title: Tidepool Integration: Authentication Changes
symptom: Tidepool is deprecating legacy authentication APIs in favor of new OAuth2/OpenID Connect standards based APIs. AndroidAPS is currently using the legacy authentication APIs and needs to migrate to the new authentication APIs.
cause: AndroidAPS is using legacy authentication APIs that Tidepool is deprecating.
fix: Tidepool provided client details for integration and production environments, including authorization and token endpoints, API hosts, client ID 'aaps', and callback URL 'aaps://callback/tidepool'. A pull request #4151 was created to address the migration.
evidence_quote: We see that AndroidAPS is currently using the legacy authentication APIs: https://github.com/nightscout/AndroidAPS/blob/master/plugins/sync/src/main/kotlin/app/aaps/plugins/sync/tidepool/comm/TidepoolApiService.kt#L28-L29
